_README: Where the vendored copies in this repository come from. Every entry is a byte-identical copy of its source in nanohype/nanohype at `upstream.ref` — never hand-edit one; fixes land upstream with their tests and propagate outward. The pin is what makes `npm run sync:vendored:check` a verdict about this commit rather than about whatever nanohype's main branch happens to be when CI runs: without it, an unrelated merge upstream turns this repository's required check red. Whether the pin has fallen behind is a different question, asked on a schedule rather than on the blocking path.
